study: Bounded multi-horizon retrospective development study; existing ten-session results already inspected; no blind confirmation or alpha claim
horizon_choice: Project choice requested by owner; official idea requires several horizons but does not prescribe this list

target_definitions.raw_price_return: stock provider daily-bar o at exit / stock provider daily-bar o at entry - 1
target_definitions.excess_price_return: raw_price_return minus same-session SPY daily-bar o return

strict_total_return_track: Unchanged; both experimental targets exclude cash dividends; no invented as-of timestamps
cached_tone_policy: Reuse only existing hash-bound per-headline FinBERT receipts. If any required headline is missing/invalid/truncated, mark both added controls for that company/horizon/pool Unavailable; do not remove rows. No new tensor inference.

pools.horizon_specific: Same source company-days; run mature chronological/event-purged eligibility separately for each horizon, retaining all exclusion denominators
pools.common_eligible: Intersect eligible sample IDs separately within train and test across 5/10/20 before model fitting; preserve anchor-ten-session ordering; never intersect on target value or cache availability; refit each horizon using identical IDs; report if infeasible

maturity: Training exit scheduled session-open timestamp must be strictly before 2023-09-01T00:00:00Z; excluded transitive event/source bridges retained in graph; no extra fixed embargo
price_timestamp_audit: Require aware daily-bar t at America/New_York midnight, unique calendar session dates and finite positive o, fixed split-adjusted SIP 1Day pagination. Scheduled calendar open is a logical label clock; exact auction/fill timestamp of provider daily o is not certified by daily t. Report this limitation.
cost_policy: Per company/horizon/target/pool, use the existing deterministic non-overlap interval selector with shared intervals for all available controls; do not compound overlapping labels or pool companies; report trade counts, held intervals, endpoints and always-company/SPY/cash. Cost-window lengths/exposure differ by horizon; no annualization or winner from cumulative returns. Actual broker charges remain unknown.
interpretation: Raw MAE scales with horizon; compare controls within horizon and common-ID sensitivity, not choose a best horizon by smallest raw error. No tuning, significance or tradability claim.
retained_existing10: Reuse existing full-pool ten-session excess-target four/six-model artifacts if exact rows and inputs match; no overwrite. Raw-target ten-session and common-pool refits are separate results.
